note: A tone in place of two colours (decision element-roles-and-reuse)

component.doc: An icon in a tinted circle (a list row's leading icon, a category): the circle in tint_bg, the icon in tint, centred. Until issue #325's renderer fix is in the app, an icon-only core://Badge draws 2 dp left of centre; this component leaves that to the renderer rather than padding around it. tone picks the theme's pair in one word (accent, success, error, muted).

params.name: icon
params.doc: An icon name or path:<svg path> (24x24, filled).

params.name: tone
params.doc: A tone instead of the two colours: accent, success, error or muted (the theme's pair for it). Empty: the colours given.

params.name: tint
params.doc: The icon's colour (#RRGGBB or a binding such as ${local://theme#accent}).

params.name: tint_bg
params.doc: The circle's colour (#RRGGBB or a binding such as ${local://theme#accent_surface}).

examples.note: a bell in the accent colours
a tick in the success tone
